ai_positioning.summary: NBT Bancorp operates as a community-oriented regional financial institution with emphasis on local decision-making and personalized service in northeastern US markets
evidence: Headquartered in Norwich, NY with established presence since 1856
Operates subsidiaries including NBT Bank (primary bank), NBT Financial Services (retirement plan administration), and insurance agency
Business philosophy centers on community banking model with local market expertise across upstate NY, PA, NH, MA, VT, ME, and CT
Provides commercial banking, retail banking, and wealth management services
